Aapki diet mein kuch khaas cheezein shamil karna aur kuch cheezein avoid karna zaroori hai, taaki aapki skin aur baalon ki sehat behtar ho sake. 

Aapko in cheezein khani chahiye:
- **Fruits & Vegetables**: Jaise berries, oranges, spinach, aur kale, jo vitamins aur antioxidants se bhare hote hain.
- **Healthy Fats**: Avocados, nuts, aur seeds jo skin ko moisturized rakhte hain.
- **Omega-3 Fatty Acids**: Jaise salmon, chia seeds, aur flaxseeds, jo inflammation ko kam karte hain.
- **Whole Grains**: Brown rice, quinoa, aur oats jo healthy skin maintain karne mein madadgar hote hain.
- **Hydration**: Pani kaafi peena zaroori hai taaki skin hydrated rahe.

Aapko in cheezein se bachna chahiye:

How can I know my skin type

You can determine your skin type by performing a simple test at home. Start by washing your face with a gentle cleanser and leave it bare for about 30 minutes. After this time, observe how your skin feels:

- If it feels oily or looks shiny, you may have oily skin.
- If it feels tight or dry, you may have dry skin.
- If some areas are oily (usually the T-zone) and others are dry, you may have combination skin.
- If your skin feels comfortable without excess oil or dryness, it is likely normal.

For a more personalized assessment, consider completing the skin analysis on the Cureskin app, where your concerns will be reviewed, and a suitable care plan will be recommended based on your skin needs.
